name: Presentify
soft_passes: #4 16px squint: board-on-easel gestalt survives but inner screen + tripod legs smear/merge
#7 figure-ground: dominant frame passes >3:1 grayscale-safe, but inner purple-on-purple screen nearly vanishes
#10 variant robustness: light glyph is bg-independent, but Big-Sur flat render has no authored dark/tinted variant; purple-on-purple collapses in tinted/clear modes
#11 personality: easel is nameable but committed direction is thin — stock 3D object on stock same-hue gradient, template-default

palette.background: ramp #9B64E8->#561DA4 (violet, light-top to dark-bottom, single hue)

light_model: single top-down, soft/diffuse; short baked ambient-occlusion under board and behind tripod; no specular glass rim, no refraction, no long shadow (system supplies drop shadow)
devices: presentation easel/whiteboard-on-tripod front-facing object (Keynote lectern lineage)
monochrome-tonal single-hue composition (object = white tint of the field's violet)
rhymes_hint: Big-Sur monochrome-tonal single-object productivity icons; Apple Keynote/iWork lectern-easel lineage; violet/indigo productivity gradients (shares hue register with corpus-mate Alcove)
notes: 256x256 pre-masked web render (transparent outside squircle), not the 1024 master — palette hexes (measured), bevel/edge softness (estimated). NOT Liquid Glass: object is opaque matte plastic, no specular/refraction/glass layers — squarely Big-Sur unified 3D-object idiom. Icon commits fully to violet identity (bg ramp matches the violet cover art = palette-coherent brand), but reserves no accent and shows none of the app's in-product annotation colors (orange/red seen on cover). Competent but anonymous: 12/12 with no hard failures yet template-default direction. Inner screen contrast is the one real weakness for small-size and tinted-mode robustness.
